summary_hint: Screenshot of the <lender_or_platform_name> portal (<screen_or_section_label>); software UI, not an underlying document.

typed_core.name: lender_or_platform_name
typed_core.why: identity — which lender/broker portal this is a capture of (e.g. UWM, uwm.com/dashboard)
typed_core.prompt_hint: The platform/lender name or portal URL (e.g. 'United Wholesale Mortgage' / 'uwm.com/dashboard')

typed_core.name: screen_or_section_label
typed_core.why: identity — which screen/section the capture shows (e.g. 'Loan Activity & Tools')
typed_core.prompt_hint: The visible page/section header — do NOT enumerate the panels' contents

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: identity — the loan number IF the capture is file-specific (ties the screenshot to a loan); often absent on an LO home page
typed_core.prompt_hint: Only if a specific loan number is shown; leave null on a generic dashboard. Captured verbatim; masked at the snapshot boundary by the global PII registry

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity — the borrower IF the capture is file-specific; often absent (it is the loan officer's dashboard)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Only if a specific borrower is shown; leave null on a generic dashboard

typed_core.name: capture_date_if_shown
typed_core.why: processor — the print/screenshot timestamp when shown (provenance)
typed_core.prompt_hint: The print/capture date shown in the browser header (e.g. '2/5/26, 10:38 AM'); date only

rejected.name: THE ENTIRE DASHBOARD CONTENTS
rejected.reason: pipeline stats, PRO ranking / points / streak, loan alerts (locks expiring / problem uploads / new conditions), leads tiles, production summary, insights, rate/lock panels — DELIBERATELY not schematized. A portal's fields change with every software release; a schema built on today's layout is obsolete on the next deploy. Identity only, BY DESIGN (see ADR for LP-466).

rejected.name: embedded_home_value_estimate / avm_value
rejected.reason: an embedded AVM block routes to home_value_estimate ONLY when it DOMINATES the capture (the A3 dominance rule). On a broad dashboard the embedded value is deliberately NOT extracted — one label per document, and an AVM is not underwriting evidence.

rejected.name: is_current / status_ok / any judgment
rejected.reason: a screenshot is a snapshot of software state, not a fact to judge. No verification flags.

encoding_variations: multi-page portal captures (061 is 4 pages) with the useful identity at the very top (URL + capture timestamp) and in the footer (lender legal name)
loan_number / borrower_name are frequently ABSENT — a loan-officer home page has a 'Find My Loan' search box, not a specific loan; capture null faithfully
an embedded Home Value Estimator block may appear amid the panels — it is NOT this type's content (see rejected)

open_questions.q: Tier 1 (minimal identity spec) vs Tier 2 (no spec, summary only)?
open_questions.recommendation: Tier 1 + minimal spec (GEET'S DECISION, LP-466): keeps the LP-441 invariant (Tier-1 iff spec) intact; 'extracts almost nothing' means not schematizing the PANELS, done as a 5-field identity extractor

notes: This type extracts ALMOST NOTHING by design. Its value is twofold: (1) it stops software screenshots from diluting `unknown` (so `unknown` stays a real signal about missing types), and (2) it anchors the AVM/dashboard routing pair (an HVE-dominant capture routes to home_value_estimate instead of here).
No PII field of its own: loan_number rides the existing global _PII_FIELDS 'loan_number' registration if ever populated; all other identity fields carry no long digit runs.
Do NOT grow this into a dashboard content schema — that is the explicit anti-goal.
